linux_run.xex_to_executable_lineage: GDB source locations resolved to the generated/default C++ tree associated with the locked manifest input. The run evidence does not contain a build invocation artifact independently binding this executable hash to the XEX hash.

writeback_observation.watch_method: GDB hardware watchpoints on the physical writeback target, descriptor base word, and predicate byte

remaining_guest_frontier.observation: The main guest thread was again polling the original software-queue predicate after the GPU readback advanced. The watched descriptor base word stayed at 1 while the distinct +0x3C GPU readback field advanced.

interpretation.supported: The retail XEX calls VdEnableRingBufferRPtrWriteBack with physical address 0x17AF403C and block size log2 6. The ReXGlue GPU worker writes successive big-endian read-pointer values 25, 49, and 73 to that location. Exact-XEX helper 0x823B2920 reads the +0x3C field, confirming that this GPU writeback path is active and progressing. The earlier no-write observation on the descriptor base word at +0x00 does not describe the GPU readback field.
interpretation.not_proven: This does not establish why the separate software queue at descriptor+0x00 and predicate bit 0x02 remain unchanged, whether that wait prevents frontend progress, or whether a visible retail frame, menu, or race was reached. It does not independently bind the generated executable to the locked XEX build invocation.
interpretation.next_p1_frontier: Trace the original worker/callback path that advances the +0x00 software queue and exact-XEX predicate bit. Preserve the retail wait and scheduler semantics until the missing transition is identified.

historical_watchpoint_caveat: The descriptor+0x00 watchpoint in this capture was placed on the virtual host mapping. It could miss EVENT_WRITE_SHD stores made through the separate physical host mapping. The later exact-XEX alias trace observed matching physical and guest-virtual values for 360 writes; see evidence/xbox360_linux_guest_ring_physical_virtual_alias_20261025.json. This file's measured writeback values remain valid, but the descriptor-stayed-at-1 inference is superseded.
